title: Yellow Yogurt Middle Eastern Chickpeas Hummus
description: A garlicky and bouncy Middle Eastern dish featuring yellow masarepa and confit tomato, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this hummus is nut-free friendly and made with chickpeas and yogurt.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chickpeas, yellow masarepa, confit tomato, yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, and salt.
Blend the mixture on high speed for about 2 minutes, or until it is smooth and creamy.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the water and olive oil.
Continue blending for another minute, or until the desired consistency is reached.
Taste the hummus and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Transfer the hummus to a serving bowl and garnish with a sprinkle of paprika or parsley, if desired.
Serve the hummus with pita bread, vegetables, or crackers.
Cover and refrigerate any leftover hummus for up to 3 days.
